text: 巴拿马经济与财政部周五表示，政府将收购巴拿马石油码头公司（Petroterminal de Panama）剩余的41%私人股份，使国家完全拥有这一战略性的能源和物流资产。此举旨在加强对关键基础设施的国家控制。
text_en: Panama's Ministry of Economy and Finance said on Friday that the government will acquire the remaining 41% private shares of Petroterminal de Panama, giving the state full ownership of this strategic energy and logistics asset. The move aims to strengthen national control over critical infrastructure.
